title: The Past and Present Lives of a Dog

series.title: The Past and Present Lives of a Dog

fullText.simplified:
十、季南死了？

    不知道过了多少天，米乐终于看见了一个公园。这个公园……这个公园米乐记得。很多年前，他和季南一起在这里跑过步。“对，是这里，就是这里！”这个公园离家不远了，米乐知道回去的路了。米乐有点儿想哭，他已经跑不动了，他一步一步向家走去。米乐站在房子前面，用小鼻子闻了闻。他站在那里等，等着等着，他看见门开了……
    米乐想摇尾巴，他轻轻地摇了两下，就停了下来。他发现出来的人里没有季南，没有他认识的人。所以这里不再是季南的家了？季南离开了这里？
    米乐难过极了，现在他真的不知道自己应该去哪儿了，他没有家了。他想起了孟婆的话。“会不会季南已经死了？季南也喝了孟婆汤，开始了新的生活？季南会重新出生，慢慢长大，可能会有新的狗，但是那只狗不是我……”
    米乐走在马路上，他累了，真的累了。他想休息，想睡觉。米乐的眼前越来越黑，他一点力气都没有了。米乐睡在地上，他不知道自己在什么地方。他会回到奈何桥吗？他会再看见孟婆吗？米乐这样想着，突然他觉得有人在摸自己的头。米乐动了动小鼻子，这个人……这个人他应该在哪里闻到过！
    米乐努力地看了看，一个小朋友在看着他笑。真奇怪，他们应该不认识啊，但是为什么他会觉得这个人他应该在哪里闻到过呢？小朋友的妈妈过来了，米乐看了一下，又看了一下！米乐闻了一下，又闻了一下！是她？！阿晴！米乐想站起来，但是他没有力气。他在地上努力地摇着自己的尾巴。
fullText.traditional:
十、季南死了？

    不知道過了多少天，米樂終於看見了一個公園。這個公園……這個公園米樂記得。很多年前，他和季南一起在這裡跑過步。“對，是這裡，就是這裡！”這個公園離家不遠了，米樂知道回去的路了。米樂有點兒想哭，他已經跑不動了，他一步一步向家走去。米樂站在房子前面，用小鼻子聞了聞。他站在那裡等，等著等著，他看見門開了……
    米樂想搖尾巴，他輕輕地搖了兩下，就停了下來。他發現出來的人裡沒有季南，沒有他認識的人。所以這裡不再是季南的家了？季南離開了這裡？
    米樂難過極了，現在他真的不知道自己應該去哪兒了，他沒有家了。他想起了孟婆的話。“會不會季南已經死了？季南也喝了孟婆湯，開始了新的生活？季南會重新出生，慢慢長大，可能會有新的狗，但是那隻狗不是我……”
    米樂走在馬路上，他累了，真的累了。他想休息，想睡覺。米樂的眼前越來越黑，他一點力氣都沒有了。米樂睡在地上，他不知道自己在什麼地方。他會回到奈何橋嗎？他會再看見孟婆嗎？米樂這樣想著，突然他覺得有人在摸自己的頭。米樂動了動小鼻子，這個人……這個人他應該在哪裡聞到過！
    米樂努力地看了看，一個小朋友在看著他笑。真奇怪，他們應該不認識啊，但是為什麼他會覺得這個人他應該在哪裡聞到過呢？小朋友的媽媽過來了，米樂看了一下，又看了一下！米樂聞了一下，又聞了一下！是她？！阿晴！米樂想站起來，但是他沒有力氣。他在地上努力地搖著自己的尾巴。

sentences.english: Mi Le didn’t know how many days had passed when he finally saw a park.

sentences.english: Yes, this was it, this was it! This park was not far from home, and Mi Le knew the way back.

sentences.simplified: 米乐有点儿想哭，他已经跑不动了，他一步一步向家走去。

sentences.english: Mi Le wanted to cry a little. He could no longer run, so he walked home one step at a time.

sentences.traditional: 米樂站在房子前面，用小鼻子聞了聞。

sentences.english: Mi Le stood in front of the house and sniffed at it with his little nose.

sentences.simplified: 他站在那里等，等着等着，他看见门开了……
sentences.traditional: 他站在那裡等，等著等著，他看見門開了……
sentences.pinyin: tā zhàn zài nà lǐ děng děng zhe děng zhe tā kàn jiàn mén kāi le
sentences.english: He stood there and waited and waited, and he saw the door open …

sentences.simplified: 米乐想摇尾巴，他轻轻地摇了两下，就停了下来。
sentences.traditional: 米樂想搖尾巴，他輕輕地搖了兩下，就停了下來。
sentences.pinyin: mǐ lè xiǎng yáo wěi ba tā qīng qīng de yáo le liǎng xià jiù tíng le xià lai
sentences.english: Mi Le wanted to wag his tail. He gently wagged it twice and then stopped.

sentences.simplified: 他发现出来的人里没有季南，没有他认识的人。
sentences.traditional: 他發現出來的人裡沒有季南，沒有他認識的人。

sentences.english: He discovered that none of the people who came out was Ji Nan. He didn’t recognize any of them.

sentences.traditional: 所以這裡不再是季南的家了？季南離開了這裡？
sentences.pinyin: suǒ yǐ zhè lǐ bú zài shì jì nán de jiā le jì nán lí kāi le zhè lǐ
sentences.english: So was this no longer Ji Nan’s home? Had Ji Nan left this place?

sentences.simplified: 米乐难过极了，现在他真的不知道自己应该去哪儿了，他没有家了。
sentences.traditional: 米樂難過極了，現在他真的不知道自己應該去哪兒了，他沒有家了。
sentences.pinyin: mǐ lè nán guò jí le xiàn zài tā zhēn de bù zhī dào zì jǐ yīng gāi qù nǎ'r le tā méi yǒu jiā le
sentences.english: Mi Le was really sad. Now he really didn’t know where he should go. He no longer had a home.

sentences.simplified: 他想起了孟婆的话。“会不会季南已经死了？季南也喝了孟婆汤，开始了新的生活？
sentences.traditional: 他想起了孟婆的話。“會不會季南已經死了？季南也喝了孟婆湯，開始了新的生活？
sentences.pinyin: tā xiǎng qǐ le mèng pó de huà huì bú huì jì nán yǐ jīng sǐ le jì nán yě hē le mèng pó tāng kāi shǐ le xīn de shēng huó
sentences.english: He remembered what Meng Po said. Could Ji Nan have died? Did Ji Nan also drink Meng Po soup and start a new life?

sentences.simplified: 季南会重新出生，慢慢长大，可能会有新的狗，但是那只狗不是我……”
sentences.traditional: 季南會重新出生，慢慢長大，可能會有新的狗，但是那隻狗不是我……”
sentences.pinyin: jì nán huì chóng xīn chū shēng màn man zhǎng dà kě néng huì yǒu xīn de gǒu dàn shì nà zhī gǒu bú shì wǒ
sentences.english: Ji Nan would be born again and slowly grow up. Maybe he has a new dog, but that dog is not me …

sentences.simplified: 米乐走在马路上，他累了，真的累了。他想休息，想睡觉。
sentences.traditional: 米樂走在馬路上，他累了，真的累了。他想休息，想睡覺。
sentences.pinyin: mǐ lè zǒu zài mǎ lù shang tā lèi le zhēn de lèi le tā xiǎng xiū xi xiǎng shuì jiào
sentences.english: Mi Le walked along the road. He was tired, really tired. He wanted to rest, to sleep.

sentences.simplified: 米乐的眼前越来越黑，他一点力气都没有了。米乐睡在地上，他不知道自己在什么地方。
sentences.traditional: 米樂的眼前越來越黑，他一點力氣都沒有了。米樂睡在地上，他不知道自己在什麼地方。
sentences.pinyin: mǐ lè de yǎn qián yuè lái yuè hēi tā yì diǎn lì qi dōu méi yǒu le mǐ lè shuì zài dì shang tā bù zhī dào zì jǐ zài shén me dì fang
sentences.english: Mi Le’s eyes were getting darker and darker, and he had no strength left at all. Mi Le slept on the ground. He didn’t know where he was.

sentences.simplified: 他会回到奈何桥吗？他会再看见孟婆吗？
sentences.traditional: 他會回到奈何橋嗎？他會再看見孟婆嗎？
sentences.pinyin: tā huì huí dào nài hé qiáo ma tā huì zài kàn jiàn mèng pó ma
sentences.english: Would he return to The Bridge of Helplessness? Would he see Meng Po again?

sentences.simplified: 米乐这样想着，突然他觉得有人在摸自己的头。
sentences.traditional: 米樂這樣想著，突然他覺得有人在摸自己的頭。
sentences.pinyin: mǐ lè zhè yàng xiǎng zhe tū rán tā jué de yǒu rén zài mō zì jǐ de tóu
sentences.english: Mi Le was thinking this when he suddenly felt someone stroking his head. Mi Le moved his little nose.

sentences.simplified: 米乐动了动小鼻子，这个人……这个人他应该在哪里闻到过！
sentences.traditional: 米樂動了動小鼻子，這個人……這個人他應該在哪裡聞到過！
sentences.pinyin: mǐ lè dòng le dòng xiǎo bí zi zhè ge rén zhè ge rén tā yīng gāi zài nǎ lǐ wén dào guò
sentences.english: This person … he must have smelled this person somewhere!

sentences.simplified: 米乐努力地看了看，一个小朋友在看着他笑。
sentences.traditional: 米樂努力地看了看，一個小朋友在看著他笑。
sentences.pinyin: mǐ lè nǔ lì de kàn le kàn yí ge xiǎo péng you zài kàn zhe tā xiào
sentences.english: With great effort, Mi Le took a look. A child was looking at him and smiling.

sentences.simplified: 真奇怪，他们应该不认识啊，但是为什么他会觉得这个人他应该在哪里闻到过呢？
sentences.traditional: 真奇怪，他們應該不認識啊，但是為什麼他會覺得這個人他應該在哪裡聞到過呢？
sentences.pinyin: zhēn qí guài tā men yīng gāi bú rèn shi a dàn shì wèi shén me tā huì jué de zhè ge rén tā yīng gāi zài nǎ lǐ wén dào guò ne
sentences.english: How strange, they shouldn’t recognize each other. But why did he feel that he must have smelled this person somewhere before?

sentences.simplified: 小朋友的妈妈过来了，米乐看了一下，又看了一下！米乐闻了一下，又闻了一下！是她？！阿晴！
sentences.traditional: 小朋友的媽媽過來了，米樂看了一下，又看了一下！米樂聞了一下，又聞了一下！是她？！阿晴！
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo péng you de mā ma guò lái le mǐ lè kàn le yí xià yòu kàn le yí xià mǐ lè wén le yí xià yòu wén le yí xià shì tā ā qíng
sentences.english: The child’s mom came over, and Mi Le looked and looked again! Mi Le sniffed and sniffed again! Was it her?! A Qing!

sentences.simplified: 米乐想站起来，但是他没有力气。他在地上努力地摇着自己的尾巴。
sentences.traditional: 米樂想站起來，但是他沒有力氣。他在地上努力地搖著自己的尾巴。
sentences.pinyin: mǐ lè xiǎng zhàn qǐ lái dàn shì tā méi yǒu lì qi tā zài dì shang nǔ lì de yáo zhe zì jǐ de wěi ba
sentences.english: Mi Le tried to stand up, but he didn’t have the strength. With great effort, he wagged his tail while still on the ground.

sentence_translations: (10) Did Ji Nan Die?
Mi Le didn’t know how many days had passed when he finally saw a park.
This park … Mi Le remembered this park. Many years ago, he and Ji Nan had run here together.
Yes, this was it, this was it! This park was not far from home, and Mi Le knew the way back.
Mi Le wanted to cry a little. He could no longer run, so he walked home one step at a time.
Mi Le stood in front of the house and sniffed at it with his little nose.
He stood there and waited and waited, and he saw the door open …
Mi Le wanted to wag his tail. He gently wagged it twice and then stopped.
He discovered that none of the people who came out was Ji Nan. He didn’t recognize any of them.
So was this no longer Ji Nan’s home? Had Ji Nan left this place?
Mi Le was really sad. Now he really didn’t know where he should go. He no longer had a home.
He remembered what Meng Po said. Could Ji Nan have died? Did Ji Nan also drink Meng Po soup and start a new life?
Ji Nan would be born again and slowly grow up. Maybe he has a new dog, but that dog is not me …
Mi Le walked along the road. He was tired, really tired. He wanted to rest, to sleep.
Mi Le’s eyes were getting darker and darker, and he had no strength left at all. Mi Le slept on the ground. He didn’t know where he was.
Would he return to The Bridge of Helplessness? Would he see Meng Po again?
Mi Le was thinking this when he suddenly felt someone stroking his head. Mi Le moved his little nose.
This person … he must have smelled this person somewhere!
With great effort, Mi Le took a look. A child was looking at him and smiling.
How strange, they shouldn’t recognize each other. But why did he feel that he must have smelled this person somewhere before?
The child’s mom came over, and Mi Le looked and looked again! Mi Le sniffed and sniffed again! Was it her?! A Qing!
Mi Le tried to stand up, but he didn’t have the strength. With great effort, he wagged his tail while still on the ground.
